title: Before he died, David Lynch talked to Natasha Lyonne about AI. “Natasha,...
content: Before he died, David Lynch talked to Natasha Lyonne about AI. “Natasha, this is a pencil. Everyone has access to a pencil, and likewise, everyone with a phone will be using AI, if they aren’t already. It’s how you use the pencil. You see?”
author: Jason Kottke
